# Recovery: Phase 3 benchmark prompt trial outputs (20 questions, trial01)

**What it is:** The raw API responses and parsed questions from the first 20-question trial of `data/prompts/benchmark_generation_v1.md`, generated by Claude Sonnet 5.5 on 2026-10-07 (UTC).
**Location:** `C:\masters_project_large\data\teacher_outputs\2026-10-07_sonnet-5-5_benchmark-trial01\` (`teacher_outputs` in `configs/paths.yaml`). Files: `responses.jsonl` (full API responses with token usage), `items.jsonl` (parsed questions), `batch_log.json` (model, effort, prompt hash, tokens, dollars, workspace id).
**Approx. size:** under 1 MB
**Backed up?** Partly. `items.jsonl` and `batch_log.json` are copied into the repository at `results/benchmark_trial/` (backed up on GitHub). The raw `responses.jsonl` is not.

## How to rebuild
1. These outputs are **not exactly reproducible**: the model's replies differ between runs (the API does not let this model's sampling settings be fixed), so re-running gives different questions. What is reproducible is the request: the slots (`python code\generation\generate_benchmark.py plan --n 20`) and the prompt file with hash `prompt_sha256` recorded in `batch_log.json`.
2. To regenerate a trial like this one: set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, then run (about $0.13, hard cap $3.00):
   ```powershell
   & C:\masters_project_large\envs\probe\Scripts\python.exe C:\dev\masters-project\code\generation\generate_benchmark.py trial --n 20 --cap-usd 3.00
   ```
   It writes a new dated folder and never overwrites an old one.

**Trial 2 (prompt v2, 2026-10-07):** same layout in `...benchmark-trial02\`, 20 items, cost $0.1765, review copies in `results/benchmark_trial/` including `..._items_verified.jsonl` (R check results). Regenerate with the same command (v2 is the default prompt); verify with `python code\generation\generate_benchmark.py verify --items <items.jsonl>`. `verify` needs R: R 4.3.1 lives at `C:\R-4.3.1` (outside the repository; reinstall from CRAN if lost) and its path is `rscript` in `configs/paths.yaml`.

**Trial 3 (prompt v3, 2026-10-07):** `...benchmark-trial03\`, 20 items, cost $0.1800, review copies (items, log, verified) in `results/benchmark_trial/`.

**Trials 4 to 7 (2026-10-07):** trial 4 (prompt v4) was refused by the API on all 20 calls (no items); trial 5 was rejected with HTTP 403 `model_access_suspended` (no items, $0); trial 6 was a one-question probe of v5; trial 7 ran the 20 questions with v5 (cost $0.1623). Folders `...benchmark-trial04` to `...trial07`; their logs and items are in `results/benchmark_trial/`.

**Trial 8 (prompt v6, 2026-10-15 UTC):** `...2026-10-15_sonnet-5-5_benchmark-trial02\` (the numbering restarted when the UTC date changed; `...2026-10-15..._trial01` is the one-question probe), 20 items, cost $0.1885. Number keys come from R and failed items are regenerated, so the folder also holds `rejected_attempts.jsonl` (empty if nothing failed). v6 is now the default prompt. To regenerate a trial like this one (about $0.19, cap $1.50, PowerShell; set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` first):
```powershell
& C:\masters_project_large\envs\probe\Scripts\python.exe C:\dev\masters-project\code\generation\generate_benchmark.py --prompt v6 trial --n 20 --cap-usd 1.50
```
To re-check saved replies without any API call: `... generate_benchmark.py replay --responses <responses.jsonl> --n 20`.

**100-question batch (prompt v6, 2026-10-15 UTC):** `...2026-10-15_sonnet-5-5_benchmark-batch02\` (slots BM0021 to BM0120; `batch01` is the 2-question test batch), cost $0.4681 plus $0.0268 for regeneration. Files: `batch_manifest.json` (batch id and slots), `responses.jsonl` (all 103 replies), `items.jsonl`, `rejected_attempts.jsonl`, `batch_log.json`; copies of items, log, rejected attempts and the `verify` output are in `results/benchmark_trial/`. Commands (PowerShell; set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` first):
```powershell
& C:\masters_project_large\envs\probe\Scripts\python.exe C:\dev\masters-project\code\generation\generate_benchmark.py --prompt v6 submit --start 21 --n 100 --cap-usd 3.00
& C:\masters_project_large\envs\probe\Scripts\python.exe C:\dev\masters-project\code\generation\generate_benchmark.py --prompt v6 fetch --manifest <path to batch_manifest.json> --retry-failed --cap-usd 1.00
& C:\masters_project_large\envs\probe\Scripts\python.exe C:\dev\masters-project\code\generation\generate_benchmark.py dupcheck --items <items.jsonl> --against "results\benchmark_trial\*_items.jsonl"
```
These items are trial items (not part of the frozen benchmark).

## Versions, seeds, and settings
- Source / model revision / API model + version: `claude-sonnet-5-5` (a pinned snapshot), effort `medium`, adaptive thinking (API default), `max_tokens` 5000, structured JSON output. Sampling settings cannot be set on this model.
- Random seeds: none for the model. The question slots are deterministic (seeded shuffle inside the script).
- Key config: `data/prompts/benchmark_generation_v1.md` (SHA-256 in `batch_log.json`).
- Package versions: `environment/requirements.txt` (`anthropic==1.11.0`).

## Verification
- Expected file count: 3 files in the output folder; 20 lines in `items.jsonl`.
- Quick sanity check: `batch_log.json` shows `items_parsed: 20` and `total_cost_usd` about 0.128.

## If it is lost
Cost to redo: about $0.13 and 2 minutes, but you get different questions. These are trial items only: they are **not** part of the frozen benchmark and must not be used for training or reused as final benchmark questions without checking their answer keys (three keys in this trial were wrong). Losing them costs nothing important.
